subject: Math
question_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mtext>What is the value of the digit </mtext><mn>7</mn><mtext> in the number </mtext><mn>472</mn><mtext>?</mtext></math>
solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Identify the place of the digit 7. It is in the tens place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: The value of a digit in the tens place is the digit multiplied by 10. So, 7 × 10 = 70.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 70</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: What is the value of the digit 7 in the number 472?
solution_text: Step 1: Identify the place of the digit 7. It is in the tens place. Step 2: The value of a digit in the tens place is the digit multiplied by 10. So, 7 x 10 = 70. Answer: 70.

subject: Math
question_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mtext>Which digit is in the hundreds place in the number </mtext><mn>815</mn><mtext>?</mtext></math>
solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Understand place values in a 3-digit number (Hundreds, Tens, Ones).</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: In 815, the digit 8 is in the hundreds place, 1 is in the tens place, and 5 is in the ones place.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 8</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: Which digit is in the hundreds place in the number 815?
solution_text: Step 1: Understand place values in a 3-digit number (Hundreds, Tens, Ones). Step 2: In 815, the digit 8 is in the hundreds place, 1 is in the tens place, and 5 is in the ones place. Answer: 8.

solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Compare the hundreds digit of each number.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: The numbers are 321 (3 hundreds), 213 (2 hundreds), 132 (1 hundred), 312 (3 hundreds).</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 3: The smallest hundreds digit is 1, which belongs to 132.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: 132</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: Which of these numbers is the smallest? 321, 213, 132, 312
solution_text: Step 1: Compare the hundreds digit of each number. Step 2: The numbers are 321 (3 hundreds), 213 (2 hundreds), 132 (1 hundred), 312 (3 hundreds). Step 3: The smallest hundreds digit is 1, which belongs to 132. Answer: 132.
